name: Semgrep
tagline: Open-source static analysis engine with a commercial AppSec Platform adding cross-file analysis and an AI assistant for triage.
pricing: Free for up to 10 contributors; Teams from $30/contributor/mo per product (Code SAST; Secrets $15) with 20 AI credits/dev/mo; Enterprise custom with 50 AI credits/dev/mo
selfHostedNote: CE engine (LGPL-2.1) runs fully local or in your CI; the AppSec Platform and Assistant are SaaS-only.
modelControl: Assistant uses OpenAI with Amazon Bedrock fallback; custom AI model provider available on Enterprise

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Cross-file, cross-function dataflow in the Pro engine; Assistant memories add project context; no ticket context.

02-rule-centric.note: Fully rule-centric: custom rules, registry, and policy modes (Monitor/Comment/Block) control PR noise.

03-dual-workflow.note: CLI, IDE extension, and pre-commit locally; policy-managed PR/MR comments in CI.

04-business-logic.note: No validation against issue trackers or requirements.

05-continuous-learning.note: Assistant Memories store triage decisions and per-project instructions; the core engine does not learn.

06-sandbox-validation.note: Static analysis only; no sandbox or runtime validation.

07-economic-transparency.note: LGPL engine is free to run; Assistant is credit-metered on vendor models, custom provider Enterprise-only.

08-actionability.note: Assistant autofix posts suggested code changes in PR/MR comments; coverage varies by rule and language.

09-measurable-roi.note: Platform dashboards track findings, fix rates, and remediation times; no dev-cycle ROI attribution.
